scope: P20 child preview reading positions, prepared content adoption, owned Office capture and status. Not whole P20 or installed-product acceptance.
implemented: Transient parent ref retains PDF page, workbook sheet/window/explicit hidden selection, and DOCX story/top-level 20-block segment. No persisted content or position ledger.
Clamp to actual new content bounds. Missing sheet/story resets safely. Never carry old cell detail, selection or feedback readiness.
PDF restoration receives and validates actual rendered page from the real worker; readiness is reported only after pixels are drawn.
Matching prepared Office data avoids duplicate OS capture. If reading position changes during preparation, reparse the desired sheet from the same capture.

Initial Office capture keeps its single bounded receipt independently of presentation cancellation. Hide/show does not retry readPending/readBusy. Explicit retry still shares a capture that has not ended.
Hidden pending status requires matching file, retry and prepared owner. A superseded capture cannot overwrite newer prepared readiness.
notExpanded: No DOCX/XLSX feedback, area anchors, Word page numbers, nested table-detail position or paragraph inner-part position.
No real Agent, account, installed app or native WebKit check.
Office browser data uses simulated capture and typed parser results, not real Tauri IPC.
